name: Exp_Bezier
summary: This EA trades based on the Bezier curve smoothing indicator, generating buy signals when the curve slopes upward and sell signals when it slopes downward. It operates on a multi-timeframe basis, using a higher timeframe indicator to signal trades, and includes both entry and exit logic with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于贝塞尔曲线平滑指标进行交易，当曲线向上倾斜时产生买入信号，向下倾斜时产生卖出信号。它采用多周期方式，使用较高时间框架的指标来发出交易信号，并包含可配置的止损和止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于贝塞尔曲线平滑指标识别趋势方向，通过比较相邻三个贝塞尔曲线值来判断趋势转折。入场条件为：当Value[1]<Value[2]且Value[0]>Value[1]时开多仓，表示曲线从下降转为上升；当Value[1]>Value[2]且Value[0]<Value[1]时开空仓，表示曲线从上升转为下降。出场条件依赖固定点数的止损和止盈，同时允许反向信号平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表按存款比例计算手数。资金管理由外部包含文件TradeAlgorithms.mqh实现，采用信号时间戳来避免重复入场。该策略使用多时间框架分析，在较高时间框架上计算指标信号而在当前图表执行交易。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Bezier curve smoothing indicator to identify trend direction, comparing three consecutive Bezier curve values to detect trend reversals. Entry conditions: a long position opens when Value[1]<Value[2] and Value[0]>Value[1], indicating the curve transitions from descending to ascending; a short position opens when Value[1]>Value[2] and Value[0]<Value[1], indicating the curve transitions from ascending to descending. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit levels in points, while also allowing opposite signals to close positions. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit share-based sizing. Money management is implemented through the included TradeAlgorithms.mqh file, which uses signal timestamps to prevent duplicate entries. The strategy employs multi-timeframe analysis, calculating indicator signals on a higher timeframe while executing trades on the current chart.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 交易存款份额，负值为固定手数
parameters.description_en: Trade deposit fraction, negative for fixed lot

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏差点数（滑点容忍）
parameters.description_en: Max price deviation in points (slippage tolerance)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 多时间框架分析有助于过滤噪音信号，提高交易质量
贝塞尔曲线平滑相比简单均线更能减少滞后性，信号更及时
止损止盈配置灵活，允许1:2的风险回报比设置
支持存款比例和固定手数两种仓位管理模式
使用新K线检测避免同根K线重复交易
pros_en: Multi-timeframe analysis helps filter noise and improve trade quality
Bezier curve smoothing reduces lag compared to simple moving averages, providing more timely signals
Flexible stop loss and take profit configuration supports a 1:2 risk-reward ratio
Supports both deposit share-based and fixed lot position sizing modes
New bar detection prevents duplicate trades within the same bar
cons: 核心交易逻辑依赖外部自定义指标Bezier，未内嵌计算，指标缺失则无法运行
没有点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生不利入场
信号逻辑过于简单，仅依赖三个相邻曲线值的比较，容易产生频繁假信号
止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值过大，可能不适合所有品种
缺少最大持仓限制和连续亏损保护机制
cons_en: Core logic depends on an external custom Bezier indicator; the EA cannot run if the indicator is missing
No spread filter, which may result in unfavorable entries in high-spread environments
Signal logic is overly simplistic, relying only on three consecutive curve value comparisons, prone to frequent false signals
Default stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are excessively large and may not suit all instruments
Lacks maximum position limits and consecutive loss protection mechanisms
improvements: 增加点差过滤条件，避免高点差时入场
增加趋势强度确认机制，如加入ADX或成交量过滤减少假信号
将贝塞尔曲线计算内嵌到EA中，减少对外部指标的依赖
improvements_en: Add a spread filter to avoid entering trades during high-spread conditions
Add trend strength confirmation such as ADX or volume filtering to reduce false signals
Embed the Bezier curve calculation directly into the EA to eliminate dependency on the external indicator

risk_points: 依赖外部自定义指标，指标缺失会导致EA初始化失败但不会阻止加载
默认止损止盈点数过大，在小波动品种上可能导致过度风险暴露
没有最大回撤保护或连续亏损限制
信号反转时同时开仓和平仓可能造成持仓冲突
risk_points_en: Dependency on external custom indicator; missing indicator causes initialization failure but does not prevent loading
Default stop loss and take profit in points are very large, potentially causing excessive risk exposure on low-volatility instruments
No maximum drawdown protection or consecutive loss limits
Simultaneous opening and closing on signal reversal may cause position conflicts

It operates on a multi-timeframe basis, using a higher timeframe indicator to signal trades, and includes both entry and exit logic with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
